question: Which divine power is invoked to protect the head and forehead?
premises: The seed syllable hrīṃ is invoked.
Protection is requested for the head.
Bhuvaneśī is asked to protect the forehead.
inference: The goddess Bhuvaneśī, associated with the seed hrīṃ, is invoked to guard the head and forehead.
plain_english: May the seed hrīṃ protect my head; may Bhuvaneśī protect my forehead.
